dialog.speaker: ronnie
dialog.text: "I barely slept. Every time I closed my eyes, I heard her voice again. Tori. My wife. Talking to me from inside a game I built. It should be impossible. But when I open my eyes..."
dialog.internal: [Visual: Morning light filters into Ronnie's messy room. His laptop screen glows softly — Tori-gatchi is still running.]
